data.name: Abjuration Sense
data.description: A wind listener develops a sixth sense for spotting spells designed to guard against his investigations. He gains a +%1 bonus on Perception checks to notice spells of the abjuration school and on Spellcraft checks to identify abjuration effects, spells, and magic items.|WizardLVL/2
